about.title: About ACM AMTICS
about.description: ACM AMTICS is the official student chapter of the Association for Computing Machinery at the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, AMTICS. We aim to create a platform for students to learn, build, collaborate and make a positive impact through technology and innovation.
